requirements.root_cause: Login could adopt a session version whose password it never verified.
requirements.correction: Issue only after exact verified password/version and current active authority are rechecked.
requirements.regressions: test_account_authority.py: login/reset overlap, old password, disabled account
requirements.paired_evidence: Baseline account behavior failures; 30 account API/PG cases pass at reviewed correction b_pa3c4x.

requirements.root_cause: Concurrent resets could collapse two version increments.
requirements.correction: Fresh target under the root-first transaction increments once per successful reset.
requirements.regressions: test_account_authority.py: concurrent/sequential reset and token invalidation
requirements.paired_evidence: Real validator rejects pre-reset/intermediate tokens; failure/cancellation rollback covered.

requirements.root_cause: Standalone confirmation consumption released last-Admin locks.
requirements.correction: Participant confirmation, invariant, mutation and required audit share one commit.
requirements.paired_evidence: Paired account baseline 18 failures/7 controls; reviewed correction 30 cases passed.

requirements.correction: Independent expiry timer plus current authorization before sends and on idle.
requirements.paired_evidence: Paired socket baseline 16 failures; reviewed correction 24 passed; final includes 1/10-connection load.

requirements.correction: Explicit common hints preserve internal/full Admin delivery contracts.
requirements.regressions: test_realtime_authority.py: audience, internal listeners, queued role loss
requirements.paired_evidence: Real ASGI/PostgreSQL authority and Redis coverage; no handshake-only authority.

requirements.root_cause: Newest-250 discovery discarded 51 of 301 events while claiming completed coverage.
requirements.correction: Raw saturation-aware pages, bounded fixed intervals, durable frontier/page and atomic acceptance; explicit held gaps.

requirements.root_cause: Account creation could retain actor authority across expensive hashing.
requirements.correction: Revalidate exact actor/session under the mutation fence after hashing.
requirements.paired_evidence: Additional material finding reproduced in paired baseline and actual API tests.

requirements.correction: Retain bounded opaque apprise:index receipts, including duplicate URL occurrences.
requirements.paired_evidence: Occurrence receipt and partial/unknown delivery evidence pass; no URL credentials in receipts.

requirements.root_cause: An empty selected voice list could fall back to the default speaker.
requirements.correction: Reject invalid selections and definitely-not-sent empty destinations; explicit all remains explicit.
requirements.paired_evidence: Baseline wfkderem failed through actual API/dispatch; corrected stw3rvc2 passed.

requirements.root_cause: Retained duplicate dependencies/raw test DBs and caches exhausted host storage.
requirements.correction: Shared read-only exact-lock reuse, pre-allocation/continuous guards, shared bulk lock and owned cleanup.
requirements.paired_evidence: 70 host tests + guarded actual Linux frontend/build proof passed; focused independent corrections closed.

requirements.correction: Run synthetic PostgreSQL as the runner UID/GID, drop every capability and preserve0700 data permissions.
requirements.regressions: test_harness_configuration.py: test_container_user_matches_bind_owner_without_restoring_capabilities; native Linux/PostgreSQL proof; complete GitHub harness
requirements.paired_evidence: Before:1host failure/30controls and real PG runner traversal rejected. After:31host passes, SQL/private permissions/traversal/cleanup pass. Actual Linux CI closure: ci-followup.json.
